output.reason: The brief is convincing because it rests on specific comparisons. Pelion, which uses the same Tessaly crews, stayed flat. Bags on the auto-read path were unchanged. During the 14–16 October natural test, counters back on Brackwater stock failed at 1.6% while kiosks on Fennick stock still failed at 12%. The next steps are cheap and clear, and the brief is honest that the cause inside the Fennick problem is still unproven.
